reviews.title: Plenty of room
reviews.comment: A great case!  The 6 fans do a great job cooling.  There is more room than I have ever had inside a case, making it extremely easy for cable management.  Very sturdy and well made.  Easily the best case I've had and for a great price.  Everything assembled and fans ready to hook up to power.  Glass panels make it look awesome.
reviews.author: Elizabeth Stewart

reviews.title: A Stunning and Functional Gaming PC Case!
reviews.comment:
I recently had the pleasure of building my new gaming rig using the LINEDEPOT ATX PC Case, and I must say, it has exceeded my expectations in every way. This case not only boasts a sleek and modern design but also offers excellent functionality, making it a fantastic choice for any gamer or PC enthusiast.
One of the standout features of this case is its full-view dual tempered glass panels. They provide a crystal-clear view of my components, allowing me to showcase my RGB lighting beautifully. The black finish of the case adds an elegant touch, making it suitable for any setup, whether in a gaming den or an office environment.
The case comes pre-installed with six PWM ARGB fans, which is an incredible value. These fans not only provide ample airflow, keeping my components cool during intense gaming sessions, but they also add a vibrant splash of color to my build. The ARGB lighting is easily customizable, and I love being able to sync the fans with my other RGB components for a cohesive look.
Installation was a breeze, thanks to the well-thought-out design of the case. There is plenty of space for cable management, which helped me keep my build neat and tidy. The tool-less drive bays made it easy to install my SSDs and HDDs without any hassle. Additionally, the Type-C port on the front panel is a fantastic feature, allowing for speedy data transfer and making it convenient for connecting modern devices.
Airflow is critical in any gaming setup, and the LINEDEPOT case delivers with its excellent ventilation options. The strategically placed mesh panels ensure that my components receive sufficient airflow, and I’ve noticed a significant decrease in temperatures compared to my previous case.
Another aspect worth mentioning is the overall build quality. The materials used feel sturdy and durable, which gives me confidence in the longevity of the case. It has a solid feel, and I appreciate the attention to detail in the design.
In conclusion, the LINEDEPOT ATX PC Case is a remarkable choice for anyone looking to build a gaming PC that combines aesthetics with functionality. With its stunning full-view tempered glass design, six pre-installed PWM ARGB fans, and thoughtful features like the Type-C port and excellent cable management, it truly stands out in the market. I highly recommend this case to anyone looking to elevate their gaming experience—it's a perfect blend of style and performance that you won’t regret!
reviews.author: Fred

reviews.title: It works but install was a nightmare
reviews.comment:
The case isn't too bad but it was a nightmare to work with. I spent 3 hours transfering wverything from my old case to the new one and installing a new cpu cooler/radiator.
So first issue is i have an ATX form factor motherboard which this case does support however i had to take off all the bottom fans and the back fan to get it in to place (bare mind you) my back place couldnt slide under the back fan cause of the small medel outline, i had to remove bottom ones because all my ports were at the bottom for usb and such, i had to completely remove the middle one because it was right over the usb 3.0/3.2 socket and that cable is too thick to move out the way and the fan cant fit above it.
As for the fans whoever wired mine mist have been an electrician iykyk cables were criss crossed everywhere light a tangle christmas light noghtmare, took me awhile to find a plug that i could put to the motherboard.
The case states that there are 2 HDD mounts which is one of the main reasons i got the case because i have 2hdd and 2ssd, the first mount is a lil metal bracket where its monted dead center of the bottom right behind the power supply(see one of the photos i linked) and that is the only spot that had holes for mounting which it cant go right behind power supply because thats where all the cables go in... the second hdd mount? Non existent the image in the store shows them next to each other? Or somehow stacked? But theres only one mounting bracket so i couldntnt mount them, i literally have them sitting in there towards the front of pc non mounted.
When u mount a radiator on top be sure to put it in last because it will get in the way of the motherboard install and cable install for cpu and such at the top of the board, and the mesh on top sits wird because they didnt rase the edges so that if u put screws in for radiator the mesh could lay flat, so the mesh looks like a bumpy road lol
Idk if im forgetting anything but all in all took me about 3 hrs because i had to keep taking stuff back out and reputting stuff back in and trieing to figure out the electricians maze of cables since i had to take out one of the fans permanently so had to rewire, its a nice case and functions fine but the design is a lil flawed for installation, maybe give an option to have fans in the box but not installed that woulda saved me alotta time lol oh and haveing the bottom part only accessible from the metal side of the case and the rear of the case, when you are installing everything on the glass side and only access to the power supply from the other side, you have to constanly keep flippping the case over to feed cables and stuff and thats kinda risky with a glass case, and also for some reason the glass plate wants to pop off if u slighty bump the pc at all which if i didnt have a bar on the side it woulda fell and shattered, i think that is everything sorry for the rant, it works great just a nightmare to work with if u are using a full sized motherboard.
reviews.author: George

reviews.title: Great Case, looks good and good airflow
reviews.comment: The case is amazing to look at. 2 clear sides of tempered glass, not plastic. The power supply is at the bottom, and there is venting all over, allowing great airflow. The included 6 fans allow it to stay cool and my new build is very happy.
reviews.author: Turner Blanchard

reviews.title: Great case for a beginner’s first pc build
reviews.comment:
Great cable management, all rgb already hooked up. Building my first pc - pic is midway through build. Still running cords etc, but the entire process has been very easy and intuitive because the case came with all hardware etc.
Note: fans aren’t the best, lower end case
Also not a lot of room if you have a 3rd pcie slot.
